listing_info.description:
Welcome to our peaceful, centrally-located, new apartment just four blocks from Salento’s town square. Enjoy easy access to quant shops, vibrant bars, restaurants, and transport to Valle de Cocora. Hike among towering wax palms, snow-capped volcanoes, and diverse wildlife. Explore the region’s renowned coffee culture with farm tours to learn about the art of growing and roasting some of the world’s finest beans. Perfect for adventure, relaxation, and immersing in Salento’s coffee heritage.

The space
Stay in our new, two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment. The master bedroom boasts a King-size bed and the second room has a comfortable Queen-size bed. Located on the second floor in the heart of Salento, Colombia. This beautifully constructed space has a lot of natural light, making it spacious and airy. The apartment has large windows that offer breathtaking views of Salento’s lush green mountains, and a private balcony where you can enjoy the serene landscape while having a local farm fresh coffee on us or relax in a hammock and take a nap. The master bathroom includes a private full bath, perfect for added convenience and luxury. Designed with modern comforts in mind. The spacious living area is perfect for relaxing, complete with a flat-screen HDTV for your entertainment and comfortable sectional sofa. The freshly appointed kitchen is fully equipped with modern, top-of-the-line appliances, making it ideal for preparing meals with ease. There is some basic exercise equipment if you’d like to get a workout before going to enjoy your day. The apartment is also equipped with a water reserve tank that ensures hot showers are always available, regardless of water supply interruptions. There is not a washing machine for guest use. Additionally, we provide a complimentary parking space where you can securely park your car or motorcycle behind a reinforced metal fence. Whether you're relaxing on the balcony with a fresh cup of coffee, exploring the nearby coffee farms, or hiking the Valle de Cocora, this property offers an ideal balance of style, comfort, and stunning views.

Other things to note
There is a video camera inside the property by the stairs facing the main Entrance downstairs.
